title: xanthium spinosum subsp. catharticum
intro: Xanthium spinosum subsp. catharticum, commonly known as Cocklebur, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestion, reducing inflammation, and relieving gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Xanthium spinosum subsp. catharticum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as stimulating bowel movements, relieving constipation, and acting as a laxative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
